title: Petz Recoverability Versus Wilson-Loop Diagnostics in Z2 Lattice Gauge Theory (2+1D): Exact Diagonalization Benchmark on Small Open Lattices
author: Lluis Eriksson
headline: SUPERSEDED BY AI.VIXRA:2601.0051V2 FOR THE CONSOLIDATED BENCHMARK
summary: This replacement preserves public version 2 and makes the series relation explicit. The exact-diagonalization benchmark remains a valid finite-size component, but ai.viXra:2601.0051v2 is the consolidated source because it retains that benchmark and adds tensor-network ladder calculations and their scope controls.

The observed Petz/Wilson rank alignment is not upgraded to a confinement-specific or thermodynamic theorem. Its absolute values remain prescription dependent, and the spectral-gap covariate leaves confinement specificity unresolved at the tested sizes.
citation_rule: Cite ai.viXra:2601.0051v2 for the combined exact-diagonalization and tensor-network benchmark. Cite this record only when discussing the standalone small-open-lattice exact-diagonalization component or its history.
status_boundary: This supersession is consolidation rather than a wholesale refutation. The finite exact-diagonalization data and stated limitations survive; the successor is authoritative for the combined benchmark and later comparison claims.
retained: The n=8 small-open-lattice exact-diagonalization sweep and reported rank alignment remain finite-size numerical evidence.
The prescription dependence of absolute Petz-type recovery errors remains an explicit limitation.
The equal correlation with the spectral gap means the tested data do not isolate confinement physics.
superseded: This paper is no longer the preferred standalone citation for the programme's Petz-versus-Wilson benchmark.
Any reading of the finite-size correlation as a universal confinement discriminator is excluded.
The benchmark scope is superseded by the combined ED-plus-ladder presentation in the successor.
successor_adds: Tensor-network ladder calculations alongside the retained exact-diagonalization benchmark.
Explicit separation between the ED BFS collar and the MPS-contiguous buffer proxy.
Additional replication, stability and confinement-versus-gap limitations.
evidence: Both records provide finite numerical benchmarks. They do not establish a thermodynamic confinement criterion, universal recovery law or continuum theorem.
provenance: Notice pages 1-2 are new. The following five pages reproduce public version 2 with identical rendered content. Frozen copies of public v2 and successor v2 are included in the package.
